query: EXPLAIN MATCH (i:V01 {uid:'V01:I04'})-[a:INTERFACE_OF]->(s:Space)-[b:BOUNDARY_PARTICIPANT]->(c:Column) WHERE a.role IN ['side-a','side-b'] RETURN i.uid AS interface,s.uid AS side,c.uid AS column,i.geometryJson AS interfaceGeometry,c.geometryJson AS columnGeometry,b.uid AS boundaryRelationship ORDER BY side,column
